name: BranchModel
title: Multiple-omega branch model

args.name: submodel
args.description: The codon model constructed for each omega.

args.name: omegas
args.description: Omega for branch categories #0, #1, and so on.

args.name: branchCats
args.description: The numbered category assigned to each branch.

description: Use a separately unit-normalized codon model for each numbered branch category. Branch category #i selects omegas[i]. The models constructed for different omegas must share equilibrium frequencies, and the topology must be fixed when categories are read from tree annotations.
